name: Olectra Greentech Ltd
tagline: India's largest pure-play e-bus maker with a >10,000-bus order book - but chronic execution misses, BYD supply dependence and broken management credibility keep it out of the 10x bucket
business_overview: Olectra Greentech manufactures composite polymer insulators and electric buses, and is India's largest pure-play electric-bus OEM (7m/9m/12m and intercity variants), supplying state transport undertakings under PM e-Bus Sewa / PM E-DRIVE. Promoter is the Megha Engineering (MEIL) group; BYD is the key technology/battery/powertrain partner.
fundamentals_table: elevated (PE was ~85x in early 2025, lower after a ~50% price fall)
~200 buses/month effective; nameplate expanding 2,500 -> 5,000 e-buses p.a.
fundamentals_narrative: The opportunity is real - a >10,000 e-bus order book and a serious government electrification push - but delivery has consistently lagged. Management has repeatedly missed its own monthly/quarterly delivery targets; the binding constraint per the last few concalls is supply-chain dependence on BYD (batteries/powertrains) plus STU-side depot/charging infrastructure delays, not just factory capacity. The stock has corrected ~50% from its highs.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock down ~50% from 52-week high, now mid-range.
sentiment_summary: First-time read of the most recent ~52 of 104 posts (Nov 2024 - May 2026). Sentiment has clearly deteriorated. Recurring themes: delivery numbers persistently below guidance ('hope investing'), Telangana scrapping a 500+50 intercity order after 10 units, Maharashtra MSRTC's Rs 10,000 Cr / 5,150-bus order axed then reinstated on a revised (and reduced) schedule, the December 2024 Mumbai BEST fatal accident (RTO later found the Olectra brakes were working), and BYD-India entry uncertainty. Multiple posters have trimmed or exited.
community_signal: No trusted-roster high-conviction buy. siddybee, who covers the name closely (9 likes on the latest post), says the repeated downward revisions mean 'I don't trust the numbers anymore and I wouldn't give a premium to this stock' - management is 'not very astute'. james_kerala cut from 5% to 3% then to nil citing execution doubts.
bse_notes: Order cancellations/scaling-back by Telangana and (temporarily) Maharashtra; a penalty of ~Rs 2.2 Cr was levied for delivery delay. No regulatory action against the company.
bull_case: Order book of >10,000 e-buses and a genuine policy tailwind (PM e-Bus Sewa, PM E-DRIVE, diesel-bus electrification)
One of very few listed pure-play EV names in India; insulator division is a quiet, steady cash contributor
Capacity is being expanded (2,500 -> 5,000 buses p.a.) and valuation has cooled ~50% from the peak
bear_case: Chronic, multi-year failure to meet delivery guidance - the core problem is execution, and it has not been fixed
Heavy dependence on BYD for batteries/powertrains; BYD could also become a competitor if it enters India
Order cancellations / rescheduling by state customers (Telangana, Maharashtra) show the order book is softer than the headline
Still not cheap even after the fall; ROE ~14% for a capital-intensive OEM with working-capital-heavy STU customers
verdict_headline: Large e-bus order book meets persistent execution failure and supply-chain dependence - not a clean 10x setup
verdict_reasoning: External-lead (EV/electric-bus name on the manual list) - the theme is attractive but the company-specific execution record is poor and well documented in the thread
No red-flag tier, but management credibility is impaired and the order book has already been partly cancelled/rescheduled
Thesis fit 'neither': a re-rating needs a sustained delivery ramp that the company has promised and missed for two years

four_box.note: Verdict: EV/electric-bus 'theme is attractive' (tailwind=yes); but 'management credibility is impaired and the order book has already been partly cancelled/rescheduled' (moat=no) - 'company-specific execution record is poor and well documented'.
